name: Viridescent-Paean
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond an orbital debris ring, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Around the signal of unknown origin, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
